description: Insert one or more transactions (1-500 per call). Returns inserted transactions plus any skipped duplicates.

apply_rules.description: If true, apply the rules associated with each transaction's manual_account_id. Defaults to false.

skip_balance_update.description: If true, do not update the balances of the manual accounts these transactions are inserted into.

skip_duplicates.description: Flag transactions that match an existing transaction's date+payee+amount+account as duplicates and skip them. Note: external_id deduplication always runs regardless of this flag.

amount.description: Numeric value (no currency symbol). Positive = debit, negative = credit. A number, or a string with up to 4 decimal places.

category_id.description: Category ID. Cannot be a category group. null or omitted means no category.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. usd (case-insensitive). Defaults to the account's primary currency.

custom_metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON object stored with the transaction (max 4096 characters when stringified).

external_id.description: User-defined external ID. With manual_account_id set, duplicate external IDs for that account are rejected.

manual_account_id.description: Manual account ID. Mutually exclusive with plaid_account_id.

original_name.description: Original payee name. Defaults to payee.

plaid_account_id.description: Plaid account ID. Mutually exclusive with manual_account_id.

recurring_id.description: Recurring item ID. The recurring item must belong to the same account.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to apply. If omitted, no tags are applied.

name: create_transactions
